capabilities.name: Fixture run
capabilities.detail: Analysis, quote, policy, approval, payment, delivery, QuickNode join and reassessment, all local. No keys.

capabilities.name: Live market snapshot
capabilities.detail: Public Gemini Exchange events endpoint, no key, no orders. Quotes show missing, one-sided, stale, crossed and closed states.

capabilities.name: Arc Testnet direct settlement
capabilities.detail: Not wired into this server. scripts/arc-purchase.ts settles through deliverPaidRequest but has not been run live in this version (docs/integration.md). Missing: the owner's approval for a live spend and a configured VERITY_ENV_FILE.

capabilities.name: QuickNode reconciliation
capabilities.detail: The real stream filter, HMAC check, replay window and finality rule run on locally signed deliveries. Live ingestion runs only in scripts/webhook-server.ts; no live delivery was received in this build (the last key returned 403).

capabilities.name: Circle Gateway rail
capabilities.detail: PR #10 reviewed: opt-in, no blocker. Set VERITY_GATEWAY_RAIL=1 to show the archived purchase. The rail is not run from this server.

capabilities.name: Grok overdue alert
capabilities.detail: Overdue events come from the ledger status. A contract model of the Grok routine opens one card per purchase and counts replays. The real routine is not called.

capabilities.name: ElevenLabs voice
capabilities.detail: Approval explanations are text. No authorized ElevenLabs integration is wired or captured.

capabilities.name: Standard x402
capabilities.detail: The transport uses Verity headers (X-Verity-Binding, X-Verity-Payment, X-Verity-Receipt). x402 interoperability has not been checked.

capabilities.name: Owner wallet approval
capabilities.detail: Enrolled owner is the public Anvil test key #3. Set VERITY_OWNER_ADDRESS to enroll a real wallet; then only its EIP-712 signature is accepted.

decision.reason: Which issuance of the NWS Central Park daily climate report (preliminary, final, or a later correction) does Gemini use to settle? If a correction moves the max across a 2°F band edge, the version used decides the outcome. No cached or free official source answered it, and catalog item 'NWS daily climate report: settlement-version check' answers exactly this gap type.
freeChecks: [fx-nyc-high-20261118] skip GAP-NYC-FORECAST: outcome forecast changes event probability, not settlement risk; research-only, no trades.

[fx-nyc-high-20261118] GAP-NYC-SETTLE: free official-source check (Contract terms PDF: Weather_Terms_and_Conditions_67323dd4-5775-48d5-bea0-c33d672d1f74.pdf, NWS Climatological Report (Daily) for Central Park, product CLINYC) -> inconclusive. Rule 13.111(i)(2) settles on the first published version that confirms the value, so later revisions and corrections do not count. But the rule text is missing a word after 'confirmation of the', and NWS publishes a same-day CLINYC before the full-day one (Nov 17: issued 4:38 PM EST, valid as of 4:00 PM, max 57F at 3:55 PM). The terms do not say whether that partial-day report counts as the first published version, so the gap stays open.
[fx-nyc-high-20261118] PROPOSE cat-nws-cli-settlement-version-v1 for GAP-NYC-SETTLE: max 50000 base units (= 0.05 USDC), unsigned.
